sections.heading: What is CVR?: Conversion Rate
paragraphs: CVR, or Conversion Rate, is a marketing metric that measures the percentage of visitors who complete a desired action on your website, landing page, or app.

A "conversion" can be any valuable action: making a purchase, signing up for a newsletter, downloading a resource, filling out a form, or starting a free trial. CVR is one of the most critical metrics for evaluating funnel efficiency and user experience.

bullets.label: Measures Funnel Effectiveness
bullets.text: Shows how well your site converts traffic into customers or leads

bullets.label: Reduces Acquisition Costs
bullets.text: Higher CVR means more customers from the same traffic, lowering CAC

bullets.label: Identifies UX Issues
bullets.text: Low CVR often signals friction in the user journey

bullets.label: Enables A/B Testing
bullets.text: Track conversion lift from experiments and optimizations

sections.heading: How to Calculate CVR: The Formula
paragraphs: For example, if your landing page received 5,000 visitors and 150 conversions , your CVR is (150 ÷ 5,000) × 100 = 3%
This means 3% of visitors completed the desired action.
